card.name: Lab clotting test and assay wording
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before laboratory test terms, such as the PT in aPTT, thromboplastin, or reference before ranges. It appears in lab interference and test-monitoring passages.

modes.label: Inside aPTT test names
modes.description: Parts of clotting test names like aPTT, thromboplastin, or lupus anticoagulant test.
modes.example: The reagents used in the a<<PT>>T laboratory test initiate intrinsic coagulation

modes.label: Linking words in test advice
modes.description: Small words in sentences about which lab test to use or how to interpret test results.
modes.example: Monitor AT activity using<< an>> FDA-cleared test and target AT activity
